title: FintechBox FX Platform showing incorrect P&L calculation for open positions
description: Traders noticed the P&L displayed for open FX positions in the FintechBox FX Platform appears wrong. A EUR/USD long position of 500,000 shows a gain when the EUR has actually weakened against USD since the trade was opened. The position was opened last Thursday.

worklogs.description: Investigated P&L calculation. The current rate used in P&L is the mid rate. FX Platform is configured to use bid rate for long positions.
Traced the issue. A rate source update last Thursday changed the rate field names. FX Platform is picking up the 'offer' field where it expects 'bid'.
Updated field mapping in FX Platform rate integration to correctly map 'bid' and 'offer' from the rate source.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Hello, I am treating this as a critical financial data integrity issue. Investigating P&L calculation logic immediately. I will need to trace what rate the system is using for the open EUR/USD position vs what it should be using.

comments.author: customer
comments.message: All open long positions appear to have incorrect P&L. The trading desk has flagged at least 8 positions where the direction of P&L appears wrong.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: I traced the P&L calculation. The FX Platform should use the bid rate for valuing long positions. I found that the rate being used is the offer rate instead. This causes long positions to show a higher value than reality (offer > bid). The root cause: last Thursday a rate source update changed the field names in the price feed - what was 'BidRate' became 'bid' and 'OfferRate' became 'offer', but there was also a new 'mid' field. The FX Platform mapping was not updated and is now reading...

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Field mapping corrected. The EUR/USD long position P&L is now showing a loss, which correctly reflects that EUR has weakened since the trade. Can you ask the trading desk to verify the 8 flagged positions?

comments.author: customer
comments.message: Trading desk confirms all 8 positions now show correct P&L direction. Some positions are showing larger losses than displayed before. Risk management is now reviewing the actual risk exposure. Thank you for the quick fix.

resolutionNote: Rate source update changed field names from BidRate/OfferRate to bid/offer/mid. FX Platform field mapping was not updated and was reading 'offer' where 'bid' was expected for long position P&L calculation. Corrected field mapping.

csat.comment: Critical issue fixed quickly. Good that it was caught by a trader rather than discovered later.
